declared_by: dig tunnel 2; declaring and the governing run are research. Building a file under runs/submissions and any upload stay the user's word.
status: DECLARED after the exploration disclosed below, on the same four development months. The governing run (tools/run_stack_resid.py --score) recomputes the development table with the declared bag. The evidence that does not come from the exploration is the label-free ranking side: the transfer guard and the dry run. There is no twelve-month check: the component tables (runs/lomo_dev, runs/dev_model_part) cover only January, July, November and December 2025.
mechanism: The shipped stack blends its members with hand-made gates and fixed shares, then v48 / the extreme-day layer / v57 reconcile with the published daily totals. A month-blocked LightGBM on the residual of that chain finds learnable structure in the members' disagreements (spread of v9 / base / mix / committee / nets / LIRF tree / LIRF net, lirf_net - lirf_tree, v55m - v46, nets - committee, stack - v9) and in the published day total against the chain's implied positive delay (per row, and the row's share of it). The members' own input families (timeline, ADS-B, weather, traffic) carry nothing on the same residual (+0.03%).

procedure.position: after v57's variance re-allocation and before the intruder stand bound: runner v55m -> v48's reconciliation -> extreme-day layer -> v57 variance re-allocation -> THIS LAYER -> intruder bound (configs/intruder_bound_v1.json)
procedure.features: 46 label-free columns (tools/run_stack_resid.py features()): the 16 components v9, residual, base, mix, lirf_tree, lirf_net, committee, nets, v30, v33 (v46-era, at the lomo_dev definitions), v46, v51m, v52m, v53m, v54m, v55m and the stack (= v55m); 13 pairwise differences; the spread (std, range) of seven components; take-off minus schedule; the ADS-B scope flag; and 12 published-day columns per (airport, off-block day predicted by v55m): the total, its departure count, the chain's and v55m's discrepancy (total and per row), the total per departure, our row count and its ratio to the published count, the completeness flag, the row's predicted positive delay and its share of the day's. The chain's own outputs (v48, ext, new) are NOT features except through the day discrepancy and the positive delay.
procedure.target: label - chain value, clipped at +-3,600 s
procedure.model: LightGBM regression, 31 leaves, min 400 rows per leaf, learning rate 0.03, feature fraction 0.5, bagging 0.7 every round, L2 50, max_bin 127, deterministic, 4 threads; at most 800 rounds, early stopping 60 on the fitting rows whose UTC take-off day-of-month is a multiple of 5 (an inner split of the fitting months only); a bag of three seeds 20261003, 11, 12 (mean)
procedure.value: chain + 0.5 x bag prediction, floor -12 s, nearest integer in an export; the LIRF population (cls LIRF_pop) and the two guard rows keep the chain's value
procedure.fitting: development month m: the bag fitted on the other three development months; ranking: the bag fitted on all four
procedure.ranking_inputs: label-free: the final-file runner's stage outputs (runs/final_dryrun/run: recipe detail, networks, leaves, stack detail v46 / v51m...v55m); v30 and v33 rebuilt with the lomo_dev definitions (tools/run_fair_weights.build); on the 7,510 LFPG July rows of v31's EOBT_1 repair the components are the shipped 50/50 blend of the plain run and runs/final_lfpg_eobt/run; the off-block day from the v55m model-part file runs/lirf_combo/export_dry/vigorous-whistle_v55.parquet (equal to v57's chain on every row); the chain value = the base file (default the uploaded v57); published totals as in tools/screen_daily_totals.published()

candidate.name: comp_pub_bag3_w50
candidate.feature_set: components without the chain outputs + published day features (46 columns)

control: runs/scout/refit/ctl_v55m.parquet column `new` (the shipped chain on the shipped model part; 322.0588 / 255.9946 / 184.0052 / 166.2473 s)

rule.text: accepted when (1) no development month (November included) is worse; (2) the equal-footing mean (January, July, December 2025) of the complete-month RMSE change is at most -0.05%; (3) each equal-footing month's paired-day 95% interval lies below zero; (4) transfer guard: for every airport, the RMS of the bag's prediction on the ranking rows (bag fitted on all four months; LIRF population and guard rows excluded) lies within 0.5x to 2x of the RMS of the out-of-month bag predictions on that airport's development rows in the governing run
rule.intervals: paired-day bootstrap over UTC take-off days, 2,000 replicates, seed 20261003

sensitivity_reported_not_selectable.name: support_guard
sensitivity_reported_not_selectable.what: the same bag, but ranking rows whose value of any of d_comp_std, d_lirf_net_lirf_tree, d_v55m_v46, d_nets_committee, d_stack_v9, p_disc_new_pr, p_own_share lies outside that airport's development 0.1%-99.9% range keep the chain's value; reported for the transfer guard only, never selected under this declaration

exploration_disclosed.what_was_seen: runs/dig/ore/ (3 October 2026): 436 label-free columns in 10 groups; month-blocked residual LightGBM at weights 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0; leave-one-group-out; component-only, component + published, chain outputs dropped, v46-era components only; seeds 20261003 / 11 / 12; LIRF rows excluded as a sensitivity; per-cell breakdown. The earlier group definitions read the published total joined on the v46 stack's off-block day (4 rows differ from the v55m day used here).
